examples.original: [clean] Identify the item you need to clean and locate it in the environment.
examples.control: [clean] Rotate crops every season so that no family grows in the same patch.

examples.original: [clean] Use the sinkbasin to clean the item before attempting to place it elsewhere.
examples.control: [clean] Plant garlic cloves pointed end x roughly a span apart in loose soil.

examples.original: [clean] Check multiple locations for the item, including countertops, drawers, and cabinets.
examples.control: [clean] Leave fallen leaves as shelter for beetles and other helpful insects.

examples.original: [clean] If placing the item in a specific location fails, try moving it to a different location.
examples.control: [clean] If the leaves turn yellow, test the soil before adding any more fertilizer to the patch.
